svg.aria-label: Three rows of 32 memory sectors of 32 bytes. Stride 1: the warp's 32 floats fill 4 sectors completely. Stride 2: 8 sectors, each half used. Stride 8: 32 sectors, each with 1 float of 4 useful bytes. The dark part of each sector is the bytes the warp uses.
svg.text: Each square is a 32-byte sector; the dark part is what the warp uses.
Memory moves in 32-byte sectors. A warp's 32 floats fill 4 sectors when neighbours
are adjacent; at stride 8 or more every float needs a sector of its own.
